latestRun.summary:
MODE: self_audit_email_only. Produce a thorough daily self-audit report including scheduled jobs, permanent rules/guardrails, health status, failures/drift, and corrective actions. Send the report by email only from cheese@luggle.com to Jon at jon@silverpine.com using the centralized email notifier API:
python3 /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/email_notify.py --to jon@silverpine.com --subject "Daily self-audit" --no-slack-notify --body "<AUDIT_TEXT>"
Do not send the report to Slack. Do not call slack_notify.py for this job. After the email command succeeds, reply exactly NO_REPLY. If email sending fails, notify Jon in Slack with only the failure reason and the corrective action needed.
